function.name: LOAD_TTF
function.abstract: It recovers a type of Truetype letter of disk, creating an internal font from the size desired.

description.p: This function recovers of disk a type of Truetype letter and creates internally the bitmaps of all characters in the standard characters game (ISO-8859-1). The function returns a font identifier (or type of letter) that can be used in the callings to functions like or .

The indicated size is an orientative value. There will be characters whose final size will be a little superior to indicated. Too, the final size of character depends of type of letter, although to a same size, a lot of types of letter must have a comparable aspect.

This function creates a font to two colours, where each pixel can be enabled or disabled. In a beginning the colour chosen to draw text is the white, but can be chosen any other colour using the function .

If you want, it is possible to save the resulting font with the function SAVE_FNT. A FNT archive is much more fast to load that a TTF font, but only holds the final font (the bitmaps of each character), while the archive TTF holds information to draw text to any resolution and size.

note.p: As much LOAD_TTF as LOAD_TTFA save information about last TTF archive recovered in memory, this allows to accelerate the following calls to the function that are made with the same font (always that those calls are consecutive). This can happen usually, for example if you want to use a type of Truetype letter to several sizes. However, it is recommended to use TTF archives of low size in disk, or to recover last smaller TTF archive at least.
